Basis: the Family Code chapter on custody (definition of custody and the custodian's fitness, the order of persons entitled, the end of custody by age, its loss and its lapse, the housing of the custodian) - check the article numbers and the 2005 amendments (Ordinance 05-02).
Definition and purpose of custody: care, education and upbringing of the child in his father's religion, protection of his health and morals; the custodian must be fit (أهلا للقيام بذلك).

Order of entitlement after the 2005 amendment: the mother, then the father, then the maternal grandmother, the paternal grandmother, the maternal aunt, the paternal aunt, then the closest relatives - always taking the child's interest into account; the judge who awards custody must also rule on the visiting right.
The child's interest (مصلحة المحضون) is the governing criterion; the judge may depart from the order for the child's interest.

Element: the dissolution of marriage (divorce judgment) with its date - check whether the divorce judgment already ruled on custody; if it did, a new claim is a transfer or forfeiture claim (custody_transfer), not an award claim.
Element: with whom the children actually live now (custody_held), their names, dates of birth and ages.

End of custody: for a boy at 10 years, the judge may extend to 16 if the custodian is the mother who has not remarried; for a girl at the age of marriage (19) - check the children's ages against these limits before asking for custody.
Loss of custody (the custodian's marriage to a non-mahram, renunciation, unfitness, failure of conditions); the woman's work is not by itself a ground of loss; but loss is a different claim.
Lapse: whoever is entitled and does not claim custody for more than one year without excuse loses the right - check when the right arose (the divorce date) and whether an excuse exists.
Custodian settling abroad: the judge may award or withdraw custody in the child's interest (custodian_abroad) - boundary.
Return of custody when the cause of loss ceases if it was involuntary.

Housing: in case of divorce the father must provide the custodian a suitable dwelling or, failing that, its rent; the custodian stays in the marital home until the father executes the judgment on housing - request housing with an amount.

Guardianship (الولاية): the father is guardian of minor children; after his death the mother; in case of divorce the judge grants guardianship to the parent awarded custody - request guardianship tied to that article.
Maintenance of the children is a separate request (nafaqa) - boundary; may be joined.
Visiting right: the judge must rule on it when awarding custody - the defendant may ask for it; visitation refusal is a separate claim.
Provisional (urgent) measures: the judge may rule by summary order on custody, visiting rights and housing (Family Code article 57 bis) - check.
Appeal: divorce judgments are not appealable except in their material aspects, but custody is a material/accessory aspect - check the Family Code article on appeal.

Provisional execution: check the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure provision that orders provisional execution by law in family matters such as custody and maintenance, and the general provisional-execution article.
Public prosecutor: principal party in all cases applying the Family Code (article 3 bis) - the petition and the file must be communicated to him.
Competent section: the family affairs section (قسم شؤون الأسرة) of the tribunal - via the court-sections module.

Territorial jurisdiction: in custody, visiting right and custodian housing matters, the court of the place where custody is exercised; check the CPCA family-matters territorial article - via territorial-jurisdiction module.
Who may bring the claim: the mother or the father (positions from the brief); standing and interest; the other relatives in the order also have standing but are outside this unit.

Proof: civil-status extracts (marriage, divorce judgment, children's birth certificates), the divorce judgment showing it did not rule on custody, residence certificate of the children, rent evidence for the housing amount.
No formal notice required before the claim; no mandatory conciliation for a custody claim on its own (reconciliation attempts are for divorce).

No limitation period of the civil code applies to custody itself; the only time limit is the one-year lapse for not claiming; check whether the court raises it of its own motion or only on the defendant's plea.
Social inquiry: the judge may order a social inquiry (تحقيق اجتماعي) and hear the child - check the CPCA family chapter.
Hearing in chambers / the family section judge's powers in the CPCA (articles around 423-428).
Mother's remarriage to a non-mahram: if the mother has remarried, the father (or another) may be entitled - check custodian_remarried events.
Boundary: custody transfer or forfeiture of custody awarded by an earlier judgment is an independent claim (custody_transfer), not this one.
Boundary: custody during a pending divorce action is decided in that action (divorce_action_pending) or by provisional measures; an independent claim may be premature.
Boundary: a foreign custody judgment needs exequatur - not this claim.
Boundary: kafala of a child is a different institution.
Petition formal elements (CPCA articles 14-15) and the fee - via petition-formal-elements.
Costs and provisional execution - via accessory-requests module.
